manifesto.title: CJP Manifesto
manifesto.subtitle: Five demands. Zero sponsors. One large, stubborn swarm.
manifesto.partyDesc: A political front of the youth, by the youth, for the youth: Secular, Socialist, Democratic, and Lazy. Reclaiming the cockroach as a badge of resilience.
manifesto.fiveDemands: Five demands. Zero sponsors. One large, stubborn swarm.

1.title: NEET Cancellation & Reform
1.desc: Nullify NEET-UG 2024 results. Constitute a judicial commission to overhaul the exam system. Re-test under Supreme Court supervision.

2.title: Anti-Paper-Leak Law
2.desc: Enact a stringent law making exam paper leaks a cognizable, non-bailable offence with 10-year minimum sentence. Create a centralised secure digital exam infrastructure.

3.title: Education Minister's Resignation
3.desc: Demand the immediate resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan for systemic failure in protecting the integrity of national examinations.

4.title: Free Legal Aid for Protesters
4.desc: Establish government-funded free legal aid desks at every district court for students facing politically motivated cases. No student should hire a lawyer to demand their right to education.

5.title: Digital Rights Charter
5.desc: Enact a Digital Rights Charter prohibiting internet shutdowns during examinations and protests. Ensure net neutrality, data privacy, and the right to peaceful digital assembly.

manifesto.joinDesc: Membership is open to the unemployed, the lazy, the chronically online, and anyone who has ever been told they amount to nothing. We are many. They are few.
manifesto.seoDesc: Cockroach Janta Party's five demands: NEET cancellation, anti-paper-leak law, education minister resignation, free legal aid, digital rights charter.

about.title: About CockroachHub
about.heading: About CockroachHub
about.partyDesc1: The Cockroach Janta Party is a satirical political party and student protest movement founded on May 16, 2026 by Abhijeet Dipke. What started as an internet meme grew into a nationwide youth movement leading the NEET paper leak protests at Jantar Mantar, Delhi.
about.partyDesc2: The party describes itself as 'a political front of the youth, by the youth, for the youth: Secular, Socialist, Democratic, and Lazy' — reclaiming the 'cockroach' label as a badge of resilience.
about.appDesc: CockroachHub is a protest resource hub designed specifically for student protesters in India. It provides verified emergency contacts, live field updates, legal rights information (BNSS-corrected), first aid guides, and mental health support — all cached on your device.
about.footer: Built for the swarm. Works when the internet doesn't.
about.seoDesc: CockroachHub is a protest resource hub built for the Cockroach Janta Party. Works offline. Zero data collection. Student support network.
